finding.summary: When k_len > n_local: The streaming (StreamingLLM) variant only keeps the `n_init` sink tokens when the KV length exceeds `n_local`; for shorter sequences it degenerates to plain sliding-window attention with no attention sinks, so the same head runs a different algorithm depending on the input length. `n_init`/`n_local` come from `config.streaming_kwargs`. finding.review_note: blind review by an LLM subagent (round 1), not human: When k_len <= n_local the sliding window already covers every key, so skipping the sink pass gives the same result; this is an implementation detail.
